title: Environmental heat and health candidate workflow
description: A learner-operated tour from a synthetic exposure dataset through transparent analysis, an emergent GIS-kernel inspection, and project mapping.
prerequisite: Import the Environmental Heat and Health Candidate project from File > Import Example Project.

steps.title: Open the saved environmental program
steps.instruction: Open the Program Editor and choose environmental-heat-health-tour. Read the synthetic-data and no-causal-inference notices before running it.

steps.title: Run the descriptive workflow
steps.instruction: Run Commands, then inspect the quality report, line list, heat-category frequency, mean heat index, 2 x 2 table, and chart. You must run the program; the runbook does not run it for you.

steps.title: Inspect the GIS kernel boundary
steps.instruction: Choose Help > GIS Kernel Lab in a new tab, select the Environmental heat-health fixture, review the effective plan, and run its bounded Worker inspection. Confirm that the receipt records the operation and limits and that no network or project mutation was granted.

steps.title: Map the packaged observations
steps.instruction: Open Maps. The project point layer uses signed five-decimal coordinates packaged with this synthetic project. The map is presentation; the kernel receipt remains the processing evidence.
